instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence. The envelope has an elegant handcrafted design in a sophisticated palette of classic pink, cinnamon pink and marsala, combining soft matte paper texture, subtle fibers, refined folds, precise geometry and delicate pearlescent details. Its ornamental wax seal is finely detailed and tactile, featuring two intertwined wedding rings engraved into the seal, clearly visible and symbolizing marriage. The envelope rests within a rich, story-driven romantic environment, such as an elegant floral garden at dusk, with softly blurred arches, lush foliage and refined wedding-inspired décor creating depth and context. Surrounding elements include marsala roses, classic pink petals, cinnamon-pink flowers, delicate ribbons, subtle golden dust and softly glowing particles, arranged organically without overpowering the envelope. Cinematic lighting with a soft warm key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, volumetric rays filtering through the background, realistic directional shadows, subtle mist and atmospheric haze. Harmonious luxury wedding palette of classic pink, cinnamon pink and marsala, enhanced with restrained champagne-gold highlights, smooth gradients, luminous accents and controlled contrast. Foreground-focused composition, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong depth and perspective. Macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture, engraved intertwined wedding rings, wax seal and ornamental details, cinematic bokeh. Photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, romantic, premium wedding invitation aesthetic. 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade rendering, visually enchanting and luxurious. Aspect ratio: 9:16.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a pristine blank sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame while preserving visible portions of the floor, background and surrounding side elements. The sheet has a refined, elegant appearance, with realistic premium paper texture, subtle fibers, softly matte finish, delicate edges and precise geometry, remaining completely empty and free of text, symbols or markings. It is placed naturally within a sophisticated story-driven environment, resting slightly above or over an elegant floor surface, with a softly blurred yet recognizable background that adds depth without competing with the central sheet. Ornamental elements are arranged organically around it, including delicate flowers, petals, fine ribbons, subtle lace details, small decorative branches and soft glowing particles, framing the paper from the sides and corners while keeping its central blank area fully unobstructed. The composition feels balanced, graceful and luxurious, with tasteful decorative accents enhancing the theme of elegance. Cinematic lighting with a soft key light illuminating the sheet, gentle rim light defining its edges, realistic directional shadows on the floor, and subtle volumetric rays filtering through the background. Light atmospheric haze and a few floating particles create a polished, refined mood. Color palette dominated by classic rose pink, dusty cinnamon pink and deep marsala, harmoniously combined with restrained champagne-gold accents and warm neutral tones. Smooth tonal gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast create an editorial luxury aesthetic. Composition: sheet sharply in focus, nearly filling the frame, with enough negative space around its blank surface for future customization, while maintaining visible floor, background and lateral decorative elements. Camera: macro lens look, slightly elevated perspective, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the paper texture and ornaments, elegant cinematic bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic elegance, premium stationery aesthetic, sophisticated and visually enchanting. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, clean, refined and suitable for elegant invitations, announcements and premium visual compositions.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Elegante) e na paleta de cores (Rosa clássico, rosa canela e marsala). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Casamento Júlia e Marcelo". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
